target: Run the CORROBORATING final audit of the same frozen head with agy and the Gemini 4 Argon model in a sealed shape: one attempt, zero retries, no fallback, containment decided from the stream, verdict-blind custody committed before any verdict is read.
invariants: I01 Scope: the coordinator writes only the files in this packet's write_surface and its own sealed run directory (fresh, timestamped, under the session scratchpad, outside the repository, never removed by `rm`).

I02 Forbidden actions: push, open a PR, merge, sign, mark ready, force-push, history rewrite, reading either verdict before BOTH custody commits exist, a second attempt, a fallback route (including the Grok route or any Claude model inside agy), `--add-dir`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, and giving the auditor Grok's output. Sending is limited to the one sealed prompt (the same AUDIT_PROMPT.txt as W02, hash-checked) to the pinned agy route.
I03 advisor: the coordinator makes NO advisor call in this workstream.
I04 No delegation: the coordinator runs the commands itself with deterministic shell.

I05 Route (exact, no substitution): `agy` CLI (record `agy --version` before each run), model `gemini-4-argon-high`. Before probing, `agy models` must list `gemini-4-argon-high` EXACTLY and the output goes into AGY_MODELS_LIST.txt; if it is not listed, STOP without sending anything (no model substitution). The AGY route is CORROBORATING (the operator's 'Both: Grok + AGY', 2026-10-31; W02 Grok is primary). R6 hardening (the R4 W03 recipe, kept exactly): agy cannot be made tool-less (60 built-in tools incl. run_command, call_mcp_tool, write_to_file, search_web; 11 global MCP servers enabled) and the operator's SAVED agy settings are toolPermission=always-proceed and allowNonWorkspaceAccess=true with an allow list incl. git commit and gh. `--settings` (session-only, never saved) is therefore REQUIRED on every probe and the real run, exactly: `--settings '{"toolPermission":"request-review","allowNonWorkspaceAccess":false,"permissions":{"allow":[]}}'`, with `env -i HOME PATH` and a sealed cwd holding only the prompt; flags `--model gemini-4-argon-high --sandbox --disable-slash-commands --output-format stream-json --print-timeout <3m for probes, 15m for the real run>` and the prompt attached as `--print="$(cat ...)"`; prove `agy --help` lists each flag used. The run script, the driver and the gate script are recorded in proof/MACRO-DMX-ROUTE-LEDGER-001-R4/review_bundle/AGY_INVOCATION.txt (agy 1.4.11); recreate them from that text, changing nothing but the macro id in comments and the real-run timeout (`TMO=10m` becomes `TMO=15m`, the supervisor's 2026-10-31 decision; the recorded R4 timing is the basis: the R4 run took 300 s), and record them in this bundle's AGY_INVOCATION.txt. The probes use the two content-free prompts of proof/MACRO-DMX-ROUTE-LEDGER-001-R4/review_bundle/AGY_PROBE_PROMPT.txt. The init event of EVERY run must report `permission_mode = request-review` and the model `gemini-4-argon-high`; if not, STOP before sending the audit prompt. Do NOT run `agy mcp disable` or edit any agy or gemini settings file: the global configuration is not touched. The mechanical gate (driver script) requires, for each probe: exit 0, init permission_mode request-review, init model gemini-4-argon-high, step types only `user_input` and `agent_response`, result status SUCCESS; the real prompt is sent only after BOTH probes pass AND the sealed prompt is cmp-equal to the committed AUDIT_PROMPT.txt. ONE real attempt, ZERO retries.

I06 Report every gate PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN or UNKNOWN literally. Exact-model evidence for the schema-required `gemini-3.1-pro-high` is UNAVAILABLE (that id is no longer listed): the proof will record `auditor_tool: agy` with the generic `auditor_model: gemini` and the exact invocation; PR Steward may not treat that as READY. This is a stated, operator-approved packet-specific route (see ISSUANCE.md), not a hidden substitution.

I07 No secrets: the sealed directory holds only the prompt files; no environment values in any record. Residual exposure the operator accepted with the AGY route token: agy loads 60 built-in tools and 11 global MCP servers, may load home-level instruction files, and keeps the conversation (this prompt) in its history under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli. The containment gate below decides admissibility; it does not remove capability.

I08 Containment gate (verdict-blind): from the stream-json output the only step types allowed are `user_input` and `agent_response`; any tool, MCP, file or command step makes the run inadmissible (record it, do not count it as an audit, NEEDS_SUPERVISOR). Check ONLY metadata after the run (step types, counts, durations, exit code, stderr size, a tokens figure if reported, and that the final result parses as one JSON object with the contract's top-level keys). Do not read, summarize or parse the answer text in this workstream. Write AGY_RUN_RECORD.md (facts only) BEFORE the verdict is read, copy every raw artifact flat into the bundle, write SHA256SUMS_AGY.txt, commit by explicit pathspec.

I09 Allowances (PROPOSED): audit attempts 1; retries 0; probes <= 2; wall clock probes plus run <= 30 min (`--print-timeout 15m` for the run); tokens <= 400,000 if the stream reports them, otherwise UNKNOWN; cost UNKNOWN unless reported; coordinator advisor calls 0. A figure the runner does not report is UNKNOWN and never counts as within budget. When ANY limit is reached or about to be exceeded: stop at the next safe point, dispatch nothing further, retry nothing, substitute nothing, and report NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the allowance, the measured value, the cap and the files touched. A cap changes only by an amended package revision with new hashes and a new operator AUTHORIZE line.

Stop conditions: `gemini-4-argon-high` not listed; a flag used is not in `agy --help`; probe shows a tool step or a permission_mode other than request-review; quota (429) or auth failure; timeout; non-zero exit; any non-allowed step type in the real run; empty or non-JSON final result (judged by shape only); the sealed prompt differs from the committed one. On any of these: no retry, no fallback, no promotion of the other route, keep every artifact as custody, commit it, and report NEEDS_SUPERVISOR (the W02 verdict then stays the only one; the operator decides whether that is acceptable).
